title: Critique: shared control models do not show shared cognition

statements.text: Describing cells and animals with the same feedback-control models leaves out how those behaviors relate, by descent and in concept, to those of organisms already accepted as cognitive.

sources.locator: section Introduction: two approaches for addressing the scope of cognition, reporting Figdor 2024
sources.quote: the phylogenetic and conceptual relationships of these feedback-controlled behaviours to those of organisms we already accept as cognitive is left out of the models
